KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES

Technical skills (manufacturing, planning, project management, industrial engineering, materials engineering, biomechanical or sport science preferred)

Analytical skills, reporting and data collection
Open mind, passionate about sports
REQUISITE EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

We are looking for world citizens with a passion for excellence, an open and inquisitive mind and passion for sports. Talented individuals, willing to learn, are fitting this job, which requires attention to details, curiosity, spirit of observation and discipline.
No previous work experience required but preferred. Vocational training (preferred in a multinational organization), MA in Engineering (Mechanical, Chemical, Industrial) or MBA preferred.
Multiple language skills: fluent English -written and spoken- required; German, Mandarin Chinese, Vietnamese, Bahasa Indonesia an advantage.
Flexibility and willingness to relocate at Company’s request.
